verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a business payments account, so AI-assisted bill capture that pre-fills payment details is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents transfers, batch payments, recipients, cards, statements and webhooks, but nothing about ingesting bills or invoices, AI or OCR extraction, or auto-populating payment drafts for review. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI read incoming bills and auto-populate payment details for my review
